About YABIMO

YABIMO is a trusted supplier of skilled personnel, engineering support and steel structures for the data center, energy and industrial industries. We support our clients with safe, efficient and reliable project execution.
We enable our customers to
  • Improve project efficiency
  • Ensure efficient use of resources
  • Meet quality and regulatory requirements
  • Maintain a strong HSE culture

With a database of over 26 000 highly qualified professionals, we bring multi-disciplinary expertise, often shaped by years of experience working in Norwegian and Nordic industrial environments.



Our construction services span the full scope - from design and documentation to prefabrication, assembly, and installation.



Our engineering services cover a wide range of disciplines, allowing us to support projects at every technical stage.



YABIMO holds numerous industry certifications, reflecting our commitment to strict environmental, health, and safety standards.

Testimonials

At YABIMO, we understand that collaboration with our customers is the key to achieving exceptional results. Every project is a new opportunity to prove our expertise and reach new heights in the quality of our services. See what makes this partnership valuable - in their own words.
I confirm that I have dealt with Yabimo in the 2023 year, where they supply Grande Entreprenør AS with steel construction deliveries to the project MegaFlis, Steinkjer, Project number 250007. They have provided our project with excellent quality of work and engineering advice. Yabimo team also looked for the best solutions for parties in the process of implementation of this job due to the tight schedule for this delivery. Their work has been a major factor in our scope of work, helping us to complete the work in a very tight schedule. I can confidently recommend Yabimo as a solid and reliable supplier, and experts in their field.
Grande Entreprenør
As the Managing Director of Eykt ehf., I have had a valued experience of collaborating with YABIMO since 2016 on several ventures, both in production and installation for: Industrial steel structures and residential projects, Bridge structures, Furniture projects, and Personnel Leasing. One aspect that truly sets YABIMO apart is the competence and expertise of their team. The engineers, project managers, and all other staff members consistently demonstrate an impressive understanding of complex technical aspects while maintaining effective communication with all stakeholders. This cohesive teamwork ensures smooth project execution and successful outcomes. In conclusion, I highly recommend YABIMO for any construction or engineering projects. They possess the expertise, a qualified staff of specialists, experience, and dedication necessary to ensure the successful completion of any undertaking. It is a great value to collaborate with YABIMO, and I look forward to future opportunities to work together.
EYKT ehf.
